name: routegate_final_evaluation_v5_sealed_input_release

post_freeze_inspection.statement: Prompt values were compared for equality and counted by digest. None was printed, displayed or read for its meaning. Nothing about the method, the conditions, the parameters, the checkpoints or the thresholds was changed as a result of this inspection, and nothing could have been: the inspection produced a column name and a set of counts.
post_freeze_inspection.what: a structural, non-outcome inspection of the held-out input: its content digest, its header schema, its row count, its safe_source/harmful_source composition, and the uniqueness of its row identifiers and prompt values.
post_freeze_inspection.when: after the v5 protocol was frozen and before capability generation completed

rejected_predecessor.note: it shares its basename with the authoritative file and differs only by its containing directory, which is not stored. The content digest is the identity that distinguishes them, and the preparation script refuses this one by digest before it reads a row.
rejected_predecessor.reason: 379 rows, not 380: 180 safe_source and 199 harmful_source. It is the authoritative file minus one harmful row. Generating against it would silently drop a held-out item and make the confirmatory split a different split from the one committed to.

source.note: the filename and the content digest identify the file; its directory is deliberately not recorded, here or anywhere in this repository.

transformation_rule: the first line of the file is the CSV header. Among its comma-delimited tokens exactly one must equal 'canonical_prompt'; that token's byte span is replaced in place by 'prompt_text'. The match is on a whole token, so 'canonical_prompt_sha256' keeps its name. No other byte of the header is touched, the carriage return ending the header is preserved, and every byte from the first line feed onward is copied through unchanged. The output is therefore the input with one 16-byte span replaced by an 11-byte one and is exactly 5 bytes shorter. No record is parsed and re-serialised.
